elements.describe: The bank 2 pre-cat sensor, hidden behind a stainless/metal heat shield on the cylinder head and under the ignition wiring harness.
Two E8 external-Torx screws holding the metal shield; nearly blind when looking from above.
The strut-tower-to-firewall brace and a large aluminum heat shield that are removed first for access.
A slim 22 mm crowfoot or offset socket seated squarely on the sensor hex with the lead fed through the slot.
Unestablished detail of shield e8 screws: Exact positions and orientation are not established; do not mark them on a specific edge of the shield.
